header: Every pick graded against real results. Nothing filtered, nothing hidden.
label: Hit rate measures accuracy, not profit. Edge requires comparing to prices.
method: Ten projected starters per game logged before tip; the graded snapshot is the last row before tip. Append-only log (data/first_basket_log.csv).
Hit = the player scored the game's first made field goal (free throws excluded). A game without a clean label is void (shown, not hidden).
Calibration cells with n < 30 are flagged thin. No tuning on these results, ever; constants frozen from the gate's 2024-25 fit (backtests/first_basket_v2_rule.md).

Shipped 2026-10-21 by CEO override after the locked gate FAILED (docs/data/first_basket_gate.json, Backtest page). Constants are the gate's published 2024-25 fit, unchanged; the gate verdict is unchanged.
